title: Introducing books to filmmakers: two documented Indian models
purpose: Strengthen the series central connection between literature, people and sustainable cinema without inferring author earnings from promotional announcements.

sources.title: Film Bazaar2023 Book to Box Office
Word to Screen Market2024 Rules and Regulations

findings.claim: NFDC documented Book to Box Office pitches in2022; its annual report identifies this as the first introduction.
The2023 catalogue shows a discoverability format: named work andauthor,language,genre,synopsis and screen representative.

MAMI2024 provides a second organised encounter between published works and screenmakers, with pitches andindividual meetings. Across-language eligibility and catalogue/openpitch selection are distinct.
MAMI lists named books as optioned through its market. This is an organiser statement about options, not evidence of finished films or source-author receipts.

editorial_application.reason: Existing labs address writing/editing; this adds published-book discovery and introductions before screenplaydevelopment.
editorial_application.proposal: Books can enter a film conversation before a screenplay exists. NFDC’s 2022 Book to Box Office brought publishers, agencies and authors before prospective buyers and producers. MAMI’s 2024 Word to Screen rules described open pitches and one-to-one meetings with rights-holders, without guaranteeing a deal.[^book-to-screen] These public and industry initiatives offer complementary examples for an Odia gathering: readers and translators could help introduce books, while authors and relevant rights-holders or their authorised representatives meet filmmakers. An introduction would leave the participants to decide what to develop together, with recognition and terms for the source author distinct from the screenwriter’s and translator’s contributions.
editorial_application.note: [^book-to-screen]: NFDC, [Annual Report 2022–23](https://www.mib.gov.in/sites/default/files/2024-05/nfdc-annual-report-2022-23-1.pdf), p. 44; MAMI, [Word to Screen 2024 rules](https://mami.mumbaifilmfestival.com/media/1301/word-to-screen-2024-rr.pdf), p. 1.
